description: CONTROL C04 (ticket 15 criterion 3): a synthetic shell case under the ticket 15 storage whose every assertion is a SKIP with a reason and whose case_outcome is SKIP. CTP counts it as a success (no NOK); the tooling must record SKIP, never PASS, with the reason, and its OOS-path evidence must stay missing. The requirement id is any valid catalogue id; the run is a control and never reaches the matrix.
